name: 55425 · Bloomington, MN
findings: ZIP 55425 (Bloomington) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55425 (Bloomington) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 55425 (Bloomington) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 4.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
